icrisat.actor: a compromised data integration or reporting path controlling a declared subset of district-level source fields before model ingestion
icrisat.scope: record manipulation benchmark; no claim of physical control over weather or agricultural processes
icrisat.constraints: non-negativity for rainfall, irrigated area, fertilizer, and acreage; training min/max and 1st--99th percentile diagnostics

hydraulic.actor: a compromised telemetry acquisition, calibration, or gateway path applying gain/bias changes to selected channels before monitoring and prediction
hydraulic.scope: sensor-report manipulation; no claim of changing the physical rig state
hydraulic.derived_channels: CE, CP, and SE are separate telemetry and change only when explicitly compromised
